articles.title: Sinner vs. Zverev: Why a 9-Match Losing Streak Might Not Matter in the Wimbledon Final
articles.summary: Jannik Sinner has dominated Alexander Zverev for years, but Zverev's first Grand Slam title at the French Open has changed the equation. Sinner calls the Wimbledon final "very, very tough" and "very different" from their past matches.

articles.title: Matt Damon Knows You're Making Stranded-in-Space Jokes—and He's Here for It
articles.summary: From The Martian to Interstellar to The Odyssey, Matt Damon's characters keep getting stranded. The actor embraces the memes, joking about the billions spent to rescue him on screen. The Odyssey hits theaters July 17.

articles.title: 10 Double Faults and a 6-1, 6-1 Loss: Alfie Hewett's Wimbledon Final Nightmare
articles.summary: Alfie Hewett's serve collapsed in the Wimbledon wheelchair final, handing Tokito Oda a dominant 6-1, 6-1 victory. Hewett joked Oda "didn't read the script," while Oda extended his Grand Slam winning streak to six straight titles.
